It could be spawned by the Krampus from its *Secret Santa* ability.
Appearance: The **Tough Cookie** was a toasted dark brown gingerbread man. It was a large figure that had a waist and lower arms in its rig. It had a cylindrical head with what appeared to have a bite taken out of it. It also had an frown on its face and three dots made of white icing on its torso, presumably buttons.
Strategy: - High DPS towers, like the Minigunner, Accelerator or Pursuit should be used as they can kill these quite easily.
- Area of effect towers, such as the Mortar and Golden Pyromancer can be quite useful against this, as the **Tough Cookie** generally spawns in small groups.

tough_cookie_cold_ambush.name: Tough Cookie
tough_cookie_cold_ambush.description: The Tough Cookie was a large enemy that appeared on Wave 10 in Cold Ambush as part of the Violent Night Event.

notice.text: Tough Cookie (Cold Ambush) has been removed from the game as of the 4th of February 2023 as it was part of the Violent Night Event.

Description: The **Tough Cookie** was a large enemy that appeared on Wave 10 in Cold Ambush as part of the Violent Night Event. It had a high amount of health, but it had a slightly slow walk speed.
Appearance: The **Tough Cookie** was a toasted dark brown gingerbread man. It was a large figure that had a waist and lower arms in its rig. It had a cylindrical head with what appeared to have a bite taken out of it. It also had an frown on its face and three dots made of white icing on its torso, presumably buttons.
Strategy: - High DPS towers like the Golden Minigunner, Ranger, Accelerator or Engineer are recommended against this.
- Additionally, you can use towers such as Commander and DJ Booth to boost these towers.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.description: The Toxic is a fast enemy that appears in Polluted Wasteland II. It has a high health and a fast speed.
toxic.mode_appearance:
- Polluted Wasteland
- Challenges
  - Oops! All slimes!

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.text: **Acid Bath** - Creates an acidic puddle upon death, which rapidly heals any enemy that is walking through it.

Description: The **Toxic** is a fast enemy that appears in Polluted Wasteland II. It has a high health and a fast speed. It has one ability where upon death, it creates an acidic puddle that rapidly heals any enemy that walks through it. It also has the Corpse attribute, making it turn into a Corpse upon death. The **Toxic** replaces the Fallen in Oops! All slimes! Challenge Map.
The **Toxic** could be spawned by the Nuclear Monster. It also could have been spawned by the Mystery in Polluted Wasteland II, starting from Wave 21.
Appearance: The **Toxic** has glowing light green skin and a dark green torso. Glowing green veins can be seen on its head and arms. It emits green pulses and particles from its torso and its head twitches when it runs.
Strategy: - Multiple high DPS towers, like the Golden Minigunner, Accelerator, and Engineer are recommended to take down the **Toxic**.
- The Accelerator's overcharge does not increase when it is dealing damage to an enemy's regenerated health, making it more effective against enemies which had their health regenerated.
- The Commander can be very useful at increasing the DPS of your towers, allowing you to deal with the **Toxics** quicker.
- The Commander can also be useful against enemies that are healed by the **Toxic's** acidic puddle.
- As this enemy is quite fast, slowing towers like the Electroshocker and Sledger can be very useful against this.
- Be careful of the **Toxic's** *Acid Bath* ability as it can rapidly heal other enemies, making it a much bigger threat when there are large groups of enemies.
- It is recommended to kill the **Toxic** as soon as possible so it does not heal enemies that are already damaged.
Trivia: - The Commander used to improperly mention this enemy as a Fallen.
- This was because the Commander's dialogue for Fallen mode was not changed in Polluted Wasteland II before the Halloween 2022 Update.
- The **Toxic**, despite being an acidic enemy, does not have any immunity to the Toxic Gunner.
- The **Toxic** is somewhat similar in terms of looks to the Toxic from *Tower Battles*.
- The **Toxic** may be based on the Toxic Zombie from *The Final Stand 2*, due to both of them having an ability to create a puddle of acid, which heals enemies walking on it.
Update History: - Health decreased from 200 to 100 in Oops! All slimes!.
- None of the changes are applied to the legacy version.
- Shield Health removed, used to be 100.
- **Bug**: Appears twice in the Index, one of them not loading in any model for the preview.
- **Bug**: No longer creates acid puddles on death, but still heals enemies.
- **Bugfix**: No longer appears twice in the Index.

toy_soldier_krampus_frosthold.name: Toy Soldier
toy_soldier_krampus_frosthold.description: The Toy Soldier was an enemy that naturally first appeared on Wave 20 in Krampus Frosthold as part of the Krampus' Revenge Event.

notice.text: Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold) has been removed from the game as of the 31st of January 2024 as it was part of the Krampus' Revenge Event.

Description: The **Toy Soldier** was an enemy that naturally first appeared on Wave 20 in Krampus Frosthold as part of the Krampus' Revenge Event. It could appear before Wave 20 when spawned by the Builder Elf. It had an average speed and a low amount of health for its debut, so it was generally not a threat on its own.
Appearance: The **Toy Soldier** was a toy that had a vibrant yellow skin tone. It was a wooden figure with a spherical head. On its head was a red hat with a yellow stripe. It wore a red shirt, had yellow plates on its shoulders and wore a black bandolier on its torso. It also had dark maroon pants with black shoes.
Strategy: - High DPS towers, such as the Accelerator, Minigunner or Pursuit can be very useful against this.
- As the **Toy Soldier** spawns in groups, area of effect towers like the Pyromancer and Mortar are very useful against it.

current.name: Toy Soldier, Evil Elf , Sleigh & Krampus

toy_soldier_cold_ambush.name: Toy Soldier
toy_soldier_cold_ambush.description: The Toy Soldier was an enemy that exclusively appeared in Cold Ambush as part of the Violent Night Event.

notice.text: Toy Soldier (Cold Ambush) has been removed from the game as of the 4th of February 2023 as it was part of the Violent Night Event.

Description: The **Toy Soldier** was an enemy that exclusively appeared in Cold Ambush as part of the Violent Night Event. It only appeared naturally on Wave ???/❄️, but was spawned earlier by the Builder Elf on Wave 19. It had an above average speed and a mediocre amount of health for its debut.
Appearance: The **Toy Soldier** was a toy that had a vibrant yellow skin tone. It was a wooden figure with a spherical head. On its head was a red hat with a yellow stripe. It wore a red shirt, had yellow plates on its shoulders and wore a black bandolier on its torso. It also had dark maroon pants with black shoes.
Strategy: - High DPS towers like the Minigunner, Accelerator or Engineer can take care of the **Toy Soldier** with relative ease.
- They can eventually become too much for these towers due to the ??? wave's health growth, so it is advised to eventually buy the plot after a few minutes.
- The DJ Booth and Commander can be useful in boosting the range and firerate of your towers to keep up with this enemy.
- The DJ Booth can also be helpful by increasing the range of your towers and decreasing their upgrade costs.
- As the Builder Elf spawns these in large groups, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies, such as the Executioner or Engineer, may need to be used to keep this enemy from becoming a threat.

trader.name: Trader
trader.description: The Trader was an enemy that appeared in Pls Donate as part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event.

notice.text: Trader has been removed from the game as of the 4th of December 2024 as it was part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event.

Description: The **Trader** was an enemy that appeared in Pls Donate as part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event. It had a high amount of health while also being quite fast, faster than the Troll. It also had 50% defense, reducing damage it received by 33% from most sources.
Appearance: The **Trader** had white skin. It wore a black suit with a red tie. On its back, it carried a Fake Rainbow Periastron. On its head, it wore a Fake Dominus Empyerus and a Fake Domino Crown. It held two fake cash bags in its hands.
Strategy: - The **Trader** has significantly more health than all enemies that appear before it.
- Towers with higher DPS, like the Minigunner or Engineer can be used, though early game towers like the Crook Boss or Militant can still be quite effective.
- Defense dropping like the Pyromancer or Electroshocker can be used to drop its defense.
- At later waves, as it spawns in hordes, they can also be used to clear out hordes of them.
Trivia: - This enemy was based on Roblox limited item traders.
- The dominus it wore, Dominus Empyreus, is one of the most expensive limiteds on the platform.
- The crown it wore is Domino Crown, one of the most expensive limiteds on the platform.
- On its back, it had the Rainbow Periastron Omega, a limited gear, though it is the cheapest out of the three it wears.
- It also held two Moneybag gears, though these are not limiteds.
Update History: - **Bug**: Jester's defense dropping does not reduce **Trader's** defense.

debuts.title: Pls Donate (Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event)

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: The Troll was an enemy that appeared in Pls Donate as part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event.

notice.text: Troll has been removed from the game as of the 4th of December 2024 as it was part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event.

Description: The **Troll** was an enemy that appeared in Pls Donate as part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event. It had high health, higher than all enemies that appeared before it, but it was slower than the Guest. On some waves, it was a Hidden enemy. Additionally, on some waves, it spawned with the Bloated attribute.
Appearance: The **Troll** was a white humanoid with a white shirt, black jacket, pants and tie. It also had a Trollface on its head.
Strategy: - Early game towers like the Crook Boss, Militant or Military Base can be useful against it.
- The Military Base can be especially useful, as its collision damage bypasses defense. The Crook Boss also can do that with its goons, though their main source of damage is their guns.
- As this enemy spawns in hordes, AOE towers like the Pyromancer, Mortar or Electroshocker can be useful against them.
- The Pyromancer and Electroshocker can also be useful at reducing its defense, though as it is quite low this is not necessary.
Trivia: - The **Troll** was based on internet trolls.
- The **Troll** had the iconic Trollface as it is an internet symbol to represent trolling, which is also applied on the **Troll**.
Update History: - **Bug**: Jester's defense dropping does not reduce **Troll's** defense.

debuts.title: Pls Donate (Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event)

uber_mystery.name: Uber Mystery
uber_mystery.description: The Uber Mystery was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, having nearly the same speed as the Quick, but it also had low health for its debut.

notice.text: Uber Mystery has been removed from the game as of the 26th of May 2020.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.text: **Spawn** - Upon its death, the **Uber Mystery** spawns a random enemy from the list.

Description: The **Uber Mystery** was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, having nearly the same speed as the Quick, but it also had low health for its debut. However, its low health was not to be mistaken for weakness as the **Uber Mystery** spawned very strong enemies upon its death.
Upon death it spawned either Molten, Dark Necromancer, Golden, Shock, Charge, Slow Boss, Hidden Boss, Speedy Boss, Abnormal Boss, Shadow Boss, Chained Boss or Giant Boss.
In Polluted Wasteland, it spawned the Amalgamation instead of the Giant Boss and the Wasted Boss instead of the Abnormal Boss.
The **Uber Mystery** used to appear in Golden and Fallen modes. It was replaced by the Mystery Boss.
Appearance: The **Uber Mystery** was a translucent, glossy red enemy with a glowing yellow question mark on its torso. It had a drooling zombie face and yellow glowing eyes.
Strategy: - Like other mystery enemies, you should be prepared to deal with the enemies that spawn from an **Uber Mystery**, with the Amalgamation being the deadliest in Polluted Wasteland and the Giant Boss being the deadliest on any other map.
- For this, the Minigunner and Outlaw can be extremely useful.
- Since the **Uber Mystery** itself is quite fast, and the fact that it can spawn extremely fast enemies (such as Shock and Charge), a Pyromancer is recommended to slow them down.
- The Rocketeer and Mortar are recommended to defeat hordes of **Uber Mysteries** as they normally spawn close to each other.
- However, be aware that the **Uber Mystery** can spawn the Golden, which cannot be damaged by splash damage towers.
- The enemies that spawn from the **Uber Mystery** do not need to be killed for wave progression to occur.
- If you are speedrunning a map, you should focus on killing the **Uber Mysteries** first before moving onto the enemies that spawn.
Trivia: - The **Uber Mystery** was similar to the Super Mystery as they could spawn enemies that did not normally appear in Golden or Fallen modes.
- The **Uber Mystery** was quite similar in appearance to the first version of the Mystery 2 which in turn, was similar to the Mystery2 from *Tower Battles*.
- The question mark on the **Uber Mystery** is a re-textured version of the Question Mark accessory from the Roblox catalog.
Update History: - **Bug**: **Uber Mystery** upon death has a chance to not disappear, instead it will have negative health and continue walking, stopping when it reaches a turn or the exit. Increases base health if it reaches the exit.
- **Uber Mystery** now can spawn the Giant Boss upon its death.
- **Uber Mystery** now can spawn the Amalgamation instead of the Giant Boss and the Wasted Boss instead of the Abnormal Boss upon its death in Polluted Wasteland.
- Removed, replaced with the Mystery Boss.

ufo_pls_donate.name: UFO
ufo_pls_donate.description: The UFO was an enemy that appeared in Pls Donate as part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event.

notice.text: UFO (Pls Donate) has been removed from the game as of the 4th of December 2024 as it was part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event.

Description: The **UFO** was an enemy that appeared in Pls Donate as part of the Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event. It had a decent amount of health decent speed and defense. It was a Flying enemy, which made it unable to be targeted by towers without flying detection while also granting it multiple immunities
Appearance: The **UFO** was a large flying vehicle that resembles a flying saucer. It was mostly blue with some blue neon parts on the sides. A giant neon blue orb was in the middle of it.
Strategy: - Towers with decent DPS and flying detection, such as the Militant, Crook Boss or Mercenary Base are recommended against it.
- Do note that for the Mercenary Base, only the Rifleman can directly target the **UFO**.
- More expensive options like the Pursuit and Ranger also work well, although beware of the Pursuit's targeting and the Ranger's slow firerate.
- As the **UFO** is a Flying enemy, most units like the ones from the Military Base cannot collide or detect it.
- However some units like Pistol Goon and Missile APC can detect and attack it.
- The Military Base can still be used to kill the **UFO** with its *Airstrike* ability.
- The Electroshocker can be quite useful to drop its defense and slow it down, since they move fast in groups and the Electroshocker is able to hit multiple **UFOs**.
Trivia: - The **UFO** is a reference to the Alien Invasion Live Event in *Pls Donate*.
Update History: - **Bug**: Jester's defense dropping does not reduce **UFO's** defense.

debuts.title: Pls Donate (Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event)

ufo_area_51.name: UFO
ufo_area_51.description: The UFO, which stands for Unidentified Flying Object, was an enemy that only appeared in Area 51 as part of the Area 51 Event.

notice.text: UFO (Area 51) has been removed from the game as of the 13th of October 2019 as it was part of the Area 51 Event.

Description: The **UFO**, which stands for **Unidentified Flying Object**, was an enemy that only appeared in Area 51 as part of the Area 51 Event. It had a similar speed as the Lawnmower, but had more health. This meant that it was a difficult enemy to kill without preparation.
Appearance: The **UFO** was a grey metallic flying vehicle, resembling a flying saucer. It had a blue glow around the sides.
Strategy: - Units can collide with the **UFO**, as its hitbox is below the mesh.
- Being slow, it means that high damage towers, such as the Sentry and Outlaw, can be used to effectively kill the **UFO**.
- The Freezer and Pyromancer can be used to slow the **UFO** down. Interestingly, the Freezer's ice crystals appear directly below the **UFO**.
Trivia: - The **UFO** used the mesh of the Personal UFO gear in the Roblox catalog.
- The **UFO** was the first "flying" enemy in the game.
- However, the first true flying enemies were the Bat and Witch as those enemies were immune to collisions, at least partially.
- The actual Flying attribute was not introduced until Hardcore Testing BETA, making the Balloon and Lead Balloon the first enemies with Flying attribute.

ultra_mystery.name: Ultra Mystery
ultra_mystery.description: The Ultra Mystery was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, being slightly slower than the Ninja, and it also had average health for its debut.

notice.text: Ultra Mystery has been removed from the game as of the 26th of May 2020.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.text: **Spawn** - Upon its death, the **Ultra Mystery** spawns a random enemy from the list.

Description: The **Ultra Mystery** was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, being slightly slower than the Ninja, and it also had average health for its debut. It could be quite dangerous considering that, upon its death, it spawned a random enemy.
The **Ultra Mystery** spawned either the Abnormal, Quick, Heavy, Ninja, or Abnormal Boss upon its death.
In Polluted Wasteland, it spawned the Radioactive instead of the Heavy and the Wasted Boss instead of the Abnormal Boss.
The **Ultra Mystery** used to appear in Golden and Fallen modes. It has since been replaced by the Mystery.
Appearance: The **Ultra Mystery** was a translucent, glossy yellow enemy with a glowing white question mark on its torso. It had a drooling zombie face and white glowing eyes.
Strategy: - Like other mystery enemies, you should prepare to deal with the enemies that spawn from the **Ultra Mystery**, especially the Ninja and Abnormal Boss.
- In Polluted Wasteland, **Ultra Mysteries** are capable of spawning Wasted Bosses and Radioactives, which can pose as a major threat.
- In this scenario, you should bring high DPS towers such as the Minigunner or Outlaw to counter this.
- The Holiday Archer helps the most against the **Ultra Mystery**, as they can kill multiple enemies, so long they are in a straight line.
- The Gladiator can hit the **Ultra Mystery** and the enemy they spawn if it is lucky enough.
- The enemies that spawn from the **Ultra Mystery** do not need to be killed for wave progression to occur.
- Due to this, if you are speedrunning a map, you should focus on killing the **Ultra Mysteries** first before moving onto the enemies that spawn.
- Splash damage towers, like the Demoman, Mortar and Rocketeer, can clear out hordes of **Ultra Mysteries** relatively quickly.
- If there are some **Ultra Mysteries** at the end of the path with low health, do not kill them as they may turn into Abnormal Bosses, doing considerably more damage to the base.
Trivia: - The **Ultra Mystery** had a similar appearance to the second version of the Mystery 2.
- The question mark on the **Ultra Mystery** is a re-textured version of the Question Mark accessory from the Roblox catalog.
Update History: - **Bug**: **Ultra Mystery** upon death has a chance to not disappear, instead it will have negative health and continue walking, stopping when it reaches a turn or the exit. Increases base health if it reaches the exit.
- **Ultra Mystery** now spawns the Radioactive instead of the Heavy and the Wasted Boss instead of the Abnormal Boss in Polluted Wasteland.

undead_solar_eclipse.name: Undead
undead_solar_eclipse.description: The Undead was the first enemy that appeared in Rotfield as part of the Solar Eclipse Event. It had average health and a slightly slow speed.

notice.text: Undead (Solar Eclipse) has been removed from the game as of the 26th of January 2022 as it was part of the Solar Eclipse Event.

Description: The **Undead** was the first enemy that appeared in Rotfield as part of the Solar Eclipse Event. It had average health and a slightly slow speed.
Appearance: The **Undead** had a similar appearance to the Undead from the Halloween 2020 Event. It had green skin, and its torso and legs were brown slate. Its rib and right leg were cut open and exposed. It was faceless.
Strategy: - A few Level 2 Military Bases can clear multiple **Undeads** out easily.
- Since the **Undead** spawn in groups, multiple splash damage towers such as the Mortar are very useful against it.
- A Level 2 Ace Pilot can be great against the **Undead**.
- The Minigunner fares well against the **Undead**, though you must wait a few waves before you can place it down.
- Many beginner towers, such as the Scout or Soldier, are good at eliminating the **Undead.**

undead_trick_or_threat_town.name: Undead
undead_trick_or_threat_town.description: The Undead was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Trick or Threat Town, and was the first enemy to spawn, as part of the Halloween 2020 Event.

notice.text: Undead (Trick or Threat Town) has been removed from the game as of the 8th of May 2021 as it was part of the Halloween 2020 Event.

Description: The **Undead** was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Trick or Threat Town, and was the first enemy to spawn, as part of the Halloween 2020 Event. Being the first enemy that spawned it had average health and a slightly slow speed.
The **Undead** could also be spawned by the Reaper.
Appearance: The **Undead** had green skin, and its torso and legs were brown. Its rib and right leg were cut open and exposed. Bone could be seen in these cuts. It also had a shocked face. Its head was slightly tilted downwards.
Strategy: - A few Level 2 Military Bases can clear multiple **Undeads** out easily.
- Since the **Undead** spawn in groups, multiple Mortars are useful against it.
- A Level 2 Ace Pilot fares well against the **Undead**.
- The Minigunner fares well against the **Undead**, though you must wait a few waves before you can place it down.
Trivia: - The shocked face on the **Undead** is based on the ﾟдﾟ emoticon, popularized from 2channel.

undead_miner.name: Undead Miner
undead_miner.description: The Undead Miner is a large enemy that appears in Badlands II. It has high health and an average speed, with 40% defense.

stats.Attributes:
- Stun Immune
- Bloated (Variable)
- Boss Immunities:
  - Freeze Immunity
  - Stun Immunity
  - Poison Slowdown
  - Confusion
  - Thorn Slowdown
  - Nuke Fallout Damage
  - DJ Booth Slowdown
  - Defense Dropping
  - Hacker Conversion
  - Hacker Slowdown
  - Slowed Immunity

Description: The **Undead Miner** is a large enemy that appears in Badlands II. It has high health and an average speed, with 40% defense. It has Stun Immunity, meaning it only gets slowed down by stuns and it cannot be knocked back. When it debuts, it is a Boss enemy.
Appearance: The **Undead Miner** is a large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has a green skin color and wears tattered dark brown overalls with yellow buttons and a buckle. It also has a brown shirt on its torso, under the overalls. It also has a dark brown helmet with an inactive lamp strapped to it. It wields a rusty pickaxe.
Strategy: - High DPS towers, such as the Ranger, Pursuit, Accelerator and Engineer are very useful against this.
- You can use towers like the Sledger, Electroshocker or Warden to slow this down.
- Do also note that freezing towers and the Warden will slow down the **Undead Miner** for a shorter amount of time because of its large size.
- You can use defense dropping towers, such as the Pyromancer or Electroshocker, to reduce its defense.
- Splash damage towers, such as the Mortar and Rocketeer can be useful against the **Undead Miner** as it normally spawn in groups during the later waves.
- Additionally, splash damage towers ignores defense, making them even more effective.
Trivia: - The **Undead Miner** is a reference to the mining towns in the American Frontier, also popularly known as the Wild West.

- In the promotional images for the Wanted Dead Update, the **Undead Miner** had its skull entirely exposed, but in-game its head is entirely green. Furthermore, it had a torn right sleeve, which does not appear in-game.
Version History: - Energy immunity replaced with stun immunity.
- None of the changes were applied to its legacy version.
- Speed decreased from Above Average (3.5) to Average (3).
- **Bug**: Appears twice in the Index, one of them not loading in any model for the preview.
- **Bugfix**: No longer appears twice in the Index.
Notes: - ↑ Only the first **Undead Miner** is a Boss enemy.

unknown.name: Unknown
unknown.description: The Unknown was a high health enemy that appears in Hardcore mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in Sandbox mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ gamepass.

notice.text: Unknown was previously removed on the 5th June 2026, though it has been made available through the Sandbox mode later.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.text: **Stomp** - The **Unknown** stomps, creating a shockwave that stuns towers and damages units by 1,000 damage.

Description: The **Unknown** was a high health enemy that appears in Hardcore mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in Sandbox mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ gamepass. It has slightly slow speed while also having high health. The **Unknown** has a *Stomp* ability that creates a shockwave which stuns towers. It also deals 1,000 damage to all units in the shockwave radius, which is enough to destroy the majority of them, with the exception of the Railgun Tank, Riot Guard and the Executioner Skeleton.
The **Unknown** can be spawned by the Void Reaver.
Appearance: The **Unknown** is a large humanoid entity, taller than the Giant Boss. It is faceless and has a grey reflective body with small humanoids coming out of it. Its left leg is twisted, and its head is slightly tilted downwards.
Strategy: This strategy refers to the state of the game while the **Unknown** still appeared in Hardcore mode.
- **Unknowns** will usually spawn in small groups. If the **Unknown** is not eliminated within a short period of time, the ability may stun many towers.
- Because its *Stomp* is smaller than major bosses' *Stomps*, it is recommended to kill the **Unknown** from a distance.
- The Ranger is a good long range cliff tower that can target this enemy at a distance, making it useful against this enemy.
- The Brawler is also useful due to its high DPS and the ability to knockback the enemy.
- They are also immune to stuns, making them even more useful.
- High DPS towers, such as the Turret, Accelerator and Golden Minigunner are required to defeat this enemy due to its high health, however they can be stunned by its ability.
- You can use the Medic to shield towers from the stun that the **Unknown** can cause.
Trivia: - This is the first and only enemy to have a *Stomp* attack that is not a major boss.
- The appearance of the **Unknown** is somewhat similar to the Void from *Tower Battles*, with the humanoids coming out of its body in the same pattern.
- Additionally, both of them have a *Stomp* ability.
- During Hardcore Testing BETA, the **Unknown** had 8,000 health.
- The death sound of the **Unknown** is a pitched down version of the Shadow Boss's death sound.
- Weirdly, the health of the **Unknown** was increased in MEGA Servers, despite it not being able to spawn in a MEGA Server without admin commands.
Update History: - **Unknown** removed from the main game, as it has been replaced by Heavy Voidling. Now appears exclusively in Sandbox mode.
- No longer appears in the Index.

unknown_boss.name: Unknown Boss
unknown_boss.description: The Unknown Boss, in-game displayed with randomly generated zalgo, is an enemy that appears in Hardcore and Voidcore modes.
unknown_boss.mode_appearance:
- Hardcore
- Voidcore
- Events
  - Halloween 2026 Live Event
  - Halloween 2025 Live Event
  - Hexscape Night III (Easy)
  - Hexscape Night III (Hard)

stats.Spawned By:
- Corrupted Conserver
- Mechanical Rot
- Primordial Drakobloxxer

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.text: **Second Chance** - Upon death, creates an explosion with a radius of 20 that applies a 60% Fatigue Debuff (27.27% DPS loss), lasting 4.5 seconds. Additionally, spawns an Unknown Small with Nimble.

Description: The **Unknown Boss**, in-game displayed with randomly generated zalgo, is an enemy that appears in Hardcore and Voidcore modes. It also appeared in Containment as part of the Hexscape Event, in the Nil Zone as part of the Halloween 2025 Live Events and in the Nil Zone II as part of the Halloween 2026 Live Events. It has a high amount of health and average speed. It has Stun Immunity, meaning it cannot be stunned.

It has one ability, where upon death, it creates a 20 radius explosion which applies a 60% Fatigue Debuff (27.27% DPS loss) to towers that lasts 4.5 seconds. Additionally, it will also spawn in one Unknown Small with Nimble.
Logbook Description: "*It’s unknown what the Unknown Boss is. What is known is that it is a cursed version of the Unknown, granted by the Void Caster — though the Void Caster herself does not know what the Unknown used to be known as, and whether the Unknown could be known is still, currently, unknown. The Elite Unknown chooses to scatter itself throughout the vastness of the Void and is usually found alone. There is not much to understand about it aside from its ability to create an internal supernova. It is taller than the Slow King and can, at random, create a smaller Unknown. Why? It’s unknown. What is known is that the Unknown Boss knows this, and would rather it stayed that way.*"
Appearance: The **Unknown Boss** is a deep purple corrupted entity. It emits glitch particles and has fingers on its hand. It has multiple small humanoids on its body.
Strategy: - High DPS towers like the Juggernaut, Engineer and Accelerator are recommended to deal with this enemy, as it has quite a high amount of health.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.text: **Avalanche** - After losing all of its health, the **Unstable Ice** will jump at a nearby tower or unit, exploding upon impact. This freezes any tower or unit caught in a range of 5 for 3 seconds.

Description: The **Unstable Ice** is a Hidden enemy that appears in the Frost mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the Operation I.C.E Event. It has a decent amount of health and moves at a fast speed. After dying, it will use its *Avalanche* ability, which makes it jump upon at a tower or unit in its range and explodes, which applies a 20% Scared Debuff to towers for 5 seconds and deals 50 admage to units. If there are no towers or units in range or only towers that cannot be targeted, it dies normally.
Logbook Description: "*After a massive avalanche, the sudden compaction of energized snow sparks new life as an Unstable Ice. Lopsided with thick shards protruding from its body, the Unstable Ice can often be found roaming the lower mountain side. The energy from the avalanche is stored within their body and explodes out after death, freezing towers and units.*"
Appearance: The **Unstable Ice** is an entity with white skin covered in a thick layer of blue ice. It has one white eye on its head. While it has a large torso and waist, its legs and arms are thin. It has additional layers of snow on its shoulders and torso, which have blue spikes protruding from them. Inside its body, it contains energy from a massive avalanche which is released upon its death.
Strategy: - Towers with decent DPS and hidden detection, like the Golden Scout, Rocketeer, Accelerator, Operator and Golden Soldier can be used to take this down.

- Although it will apply debuffs to towers, it will actually not target any tower with the Stun Immunity, making it either target another tower or if there are no towers without Stun Immunity in its range, it will simply disappear.

- Do note however that this does not make them immune to the debuff, as they will still receive it if there is a tower next to them without Stun Immunity that gets targeted. This means the only way to benefit from this is having towers with it separated from towers without it, which often is not the optimal way to play.
- As the Medic gives towers Stun Immunity with its *Ubercharge*, it can be used to protect them from being targeted by the **Unstable Ice**.
Trivia: - The **Unstable Ice** is unaffected by enemy appearance modifiers, such as Talk Like a Pirate Day.
Update History: - **Unstable Ice** removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in Sandbox mode.
- **Unstable Ice** re-added to the main game, now appears in Frost mode.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.text: **Flash Freeze** - Upon its death, the **Unstable Ice** freezes all towers in a large radius. This attack deals 80 damage to units if caught in the blast radius.

Description: The **Unstable Ice** was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Outpost 32 as part of the Frost Invasion Event. Currently, it can be spawned in the Sandbox mode, though it copies the Operation I.C.E Event Unstable Ice statistics. For its debut, it had a decent amount of health and walked slightly faster than the Snowy. It had an ability, *Flash Freeze*, where upon its death, the **Unstable Ice** would expand into an ice bubble which would freeze all towers within the radius, including cliff and air-based towers. This allowed enemies with much greater health, like the Snow Golem and Frost Invader, to seep through your defenses while your towers were stunned. However, it no longer creates an explosion upon death in Sandbox mode.
The Frost Mystery had a chance to spawn the **Unstable Ice** upon its death, from wave 13 onwards.
Appearance: The **Unstable Ice** has neon blue skin with a dark blue translucent outline encapsulating its entire body. Dark blue translucent spikes can be seen on its shoulders and on the tops of its arms. The **Unstable Ice** is faceless. Small ice particles are emitted from its torso.
Event Strategy: As this enemy only appears through Sandbox mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without Sandbox mode in Outpost 32 is listed instead.
- You can use long-range towers, like the Ranger, to kill the **Unstable Ice** from a long distance, preventing your towers from being stunned.
- Fast-firing towers, like the Minigunner and Accelerator, can quickly kill the **Unstable Ice**.
- However, they risk getting frozen when the **Unstable Ice** dies.
- Short-range towers, like the Gladiator or Sledger, are not recommended against the **Unstable Ice**, as their short range means they are much more likely to get stunned by the **Unstable Ice**.
- The Gladiator cannot block the **Unstable Ice's** *Flash Freeze*.
- The Medic is not immune to the **Unstable Ice's** *Flash Freeze*, nor can it unfreeze towers that have been frozen by the **Unstable Ice**.
- While the Military Base units cannot be frozen by the **Unstable Ice**, if a unit is caught in the **Unstable Ice's** *Flash Freeze* radius, the unit will be dealt 80 damage.
- This means that the Tank and Railgun Tank are the only viable units that can be used against the **Unstable Ice**.
- The Crook Boss' units will be instantly killed if they are caught in the **Unstable Ice's** *Flash Freeze*.
- Air-based towers, like the Ace Pilot and Pursuit, will be frozen by the **Unstable Ice**, if their tower (runway and helipad, respectively) are caught in the *Flash Freeze* radius.
- If the **Unstable Ice** is on fire as it dies (due to the Pyromancer), the radius of *Flash Freeze* is reduced by 33%.
- Additionally, as with all enemies in the Frost Invasion Event, the Pyromancer deals double fire damage to the **Unstable Ice** (though normal damage is not doubled).
Trivia: - The explosion that the **Unstable Ice** created upon its death had a unique studded texture at the top.
- This explosion also emitted light for a short time.
Update History: - **Unstable Ice** can now be summoned in Sandbox mode, only when the player has the Unstable Ice's Logbook from the Operation I.C.E Event.
- No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in Sandbox mode.

abilities.text: **Blinding Carom** - The **Vindicator** will throw its hammer at a random tower or unit in its range of 30, which will hit it then bounce to another tower or unit in a range of 5. Can only up to six targets. Any tower hit will receive an 100% Scared Debuff while units will receive 100 damage.

Description: The **Vindicator** is a strong enemy that appears in both Hardcore and Voidcore modes. It has high health and Shield Health. It by default has 100% Defense, which reduces most sources of damage by 50%, but while its Shield Health is not depleted it has a forcefield which also gives it Blessed, increasing the Defense to 200% which reduces damage taken by 66.67%.

It has one ability where it will throw its hammer at a tower or unit in a range of 30, which will then bounce to another target in a range of 5 of the previous one. It will bounce up to six times before returning. Any tower hit will receive an 100% Scared Debuff, reducing their range to 0 if there are no buffs applied to its range. In case of towers with the Stun Immunity, the **Vindicator** will not directly target them, though if the hammer does bounce to them, they will not receive the Scared Debuff. Towards units, it will simply deal 100 damage.
Logbook Description: "*The Vindicators are the trusted Do-Gooders of the Void. They act as enforcement and will not tolerate insubordination. Before the battle alongside Lord Exo, Vindicators would often patrol the ranks of Void Caster’s army to keep order and offer swift judgement upon those who step out of line. They don’t particularly have a high tolerance for nonsense or tomfoolery. Sometimes, a little dilly dallying they will overlook. If one is being a bit too silly for their liking, they will drop their hammer atop them to keep them still. It’s of no concern if the creature survives or not.*"
Appearance: The **Vindicator** has a black body. It wears full body armor consisting of a purple helmet, chestplate, shoulder-pads, leggings and shoes. On its back, it wears a purple cape and has two rows of three crystals floating behind it. It has small purple wings on its helmet and purple flowers on its chest. While it has its Shield Health, it has a purple forcefield around itself and also carries a shield. Once it is depleted, the forcefield will disappear and it will throw its shield away. It carries a hammer it uses that it throws at towers and units.
Strategy: - The **Vindicator** has high health, and a slow-medium speed, so it is recommended to bring high DPS towers such as the Accelerator, Engineer, Ranger, Turret, Minigunner or Juggernaut.

- While one would think towers like the Ranger or Pursuit would not benefit from their Stun Immunity due to the **Vindicator** applying the Scared Debuff, the **Vindicator** will oddly not target them and if the hammer does bounce to them, it will not apply anything, making them quite decent picks against it.

- The **Vindicator** will only deal 100 damage to any hit unit and will not reduce their range, making DPS towers reliant on units like the Engineer, Mercenary Base or Necromancer useful against this.
- The collision damage of units also bypasses Defense, making them especially useful.
- Although the Warlock's ranged range is fully affected, the melee range despite visually disappearing actually still exists, allowing the Warlock to stll attack.
- The DJ Booth and Commander can be used to boost the DPS of your towers.
- The DJ Booth can also be used to partially mitigate its Scared Debuff.
- The top path Juggernaut can be used to reduce the duration of the Scared Debuff on towers.
- The Medic cannot be used to prevent it, as the shield does not protect towers from debuffs.
- The Field Medic can also be used to protect units from damage.
- Defense melting towers like the Pyromancer, Freezer, DJ Booth Frost Blaster or Electroshocker can be useful at reducing its extremely high Defense.
Trivia: - The **Vindicator** has the highest Defense of any enemy in the game, at 150%. The enemy with the second highest Defense is the Gravestone, which has 130% Defense.
- The **Vindicator** is unaffected by enemy appearance modifiers, such as Talk Like a Pirate Day.
Update History: - Cash given on death decreased from $60,000 to $30,000 in Voidcore mode.
Notes: - ↑ Only the first **Vindicator** that spawns is a Boss.

abilities.label: Ability 1

Description: The **Vindicator** was a high health enemy that only appeared in Hardcore mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in Sandbox mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ gamepass. While it walks at a below average speed, it has an incredibly high amount of health. When it spawns, it does so with its *Shield* held up in front of it. This gives the **Vindicator** 5,000 Shield Health and a defense of 100%. This Defense decreases damage by 50%, the highest amount in the game, effectively doubling the **Vindicator's** Shield Health. However, due to damage dealt always rounding up, this is not always the case.

The **Vindicator** can also attack towers with its *Hammer* move. It throws its hammer at a group of towers, ricocheting off a couple before returning back to the **Vindicator**. This stuns any towers hit for a period of time and deals at least 120 damage to units.
Appearance: The **Vindicator** has purple granite armor. The armor has large purple pauldrons and glowing purple parts. It has reflective purple skin and black gloves. Its torso and legs are grey granite. It also has purple granite boots. It wears a purple helmet, wears a cape and has glowing purple spikes on its back. It wields a hammer which it uses to throw at towers. It spawns with a purple shield.
Strategy: This strategy refers to the state of the game while the **Invisible** still appeared in the Hardcore mode.
- High DPS towers are highly recommended against the **Vindicator**.
- You can use the Commander to boost the firerate of the aforementioned towers.
- The DJ Booth can be used to increase the range of your towers, so that the **Vindicator** always stays within the range of your towers.
- Try to destroy the **Vindicator's** *Shield* as fast as possible as it gives the **Vindicator** high defense.
- The Ranger is best combined with the Commander's *Call to Arms* ability so that the **Vindicator's** *Shield* is quickly destroyed.
- Units from the Military Base can deal full collision damage to the **Vindicator** while its *Shield* is up.
- Ranged damage from the units is still decreased to defense.
- Do note that the **Vindicator's** *Hammer* ability can damage units.
- Defense dropping towers, like the Pyromancer and Freezer can be very useful in reducing its *Shield* defense, allowing your towers to deal even more damage.
- Setting some Rangers to target *Strongest* may help defeat the **Vindicator** faster. Using Rangers is advantageous because it cannot be stunned by the **Vindicator**.
- Be aware that this will allow some other enemies, like the Unknown, to go further along the path.
- When the Void Reaver appears, the Ranger will target that instead of the **Vindicator**.
Trivia: - The **Vindicator's** hammer is the Mjölnir, the hammer of Thor from Norse mythology.
- The **Vindicator** is similar in appearance to the Fallen Titan as both have a purple color scheme and wield a hammer.
- The **Vindicator** is the only Hardcore enemy not to be present during Hardcore testing.

- It was first present in a public beta test for Hardcore mode made few days before the Overhaul Update released. In there, it actually spawned as a Boss enemy, though this never made it into the actual game.
- The **Vindicator's** shield is a re-textured version of the shield from the Orinthian Sword and Shield gear from the Roblox catalog.
- A few **Vindicators** can be seen standing around the Unknown Garden map.
Update History: - Defense with Shield changed from 100 to 100%.
- **Vindicator** removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in Sandbox mode.
- No longer appears in the Index.
